name: bundle-size-watch
description: Compares bundle size after each build and warns when it grows.

growthPercent.title: Warn above growth (%)
growthPercent.description: A toast appears when a build is bigger than the previous one by more than this many percent.

outputDirs.title: Output folders
outputDirs.description: Comma-separated build output folders, relative to the project. The one a build just wrote to is measured.

gzip.title: Estimate gzip size
gzip.description: Also gzip the ten largest JS/CSS/HTML files to estimate what users download.
